request: pomodoro 25/5 with a long break after 4
program:
app "Pomodoro" timer ink
state phase pick Work|Break|Long = Work
state round num = 1
state held dur = 25m
state ends when = now
state going bool = no
when going and phase = Work and round < 4 and now >= ends set phase = Break then set ends = now + 5m then notify "Break time"
when going and phase = Work and round >= 4 and now >= ends set phase = Long then set ends = now + 15m then notify "Long break"
when going and phase = Break and now >= ends set phase = Work then set round = round + 1 then set ends = now + 25m then notify "Back to work"
when going and phase = Long and now >= ends set phase = Work then set round = 1 then set ends = now + 25m then notify "New cycle"
"Round" round "of 4" head align center
text phase color if(phase = Work, accent, good) align center
text if(going, max(ends - now, 0s), held) huge align center
row gap 1
  if going
    button "Pause" tap set held = ends - now then set going = no
  else
    button "Start" tap set ends = now + held then set going = yes
  button "Reset" tap set going = no then set phase = Work then set round = 1 then set held = 25m
describe:
Pomodoro, in the ink colours.
Remembers while you use it: phase, starting at Work; round, starting at 1; held, starting at 25 minutes; ends, starting at now; going, starting at no.
Shows:
- when going and phase is Work and round is less than 4 and now is at least ends, it sets phase to Break, then sets ends to now plus 5 minutes, then shows the notice "Break time".
- when going and phase is Work and round is at least 4 and now is at least ends, it sets phase to Long, then sets ends to now plus 15 minutes, then shows the notice "Long break".
- when going and phase is Break and now is at least ends, it sets phase to Work, then sets round to round plus 1, then sets ends to now plus 25 minutes, then shows the notice "Back to work".
- when going and phase is Long and now is at least ends, it sets phase to Work, then sets round to 1, then sets ends to now plus 25 minutes, then shows the notice "New cycle".
- text: "Round", round, "of 4".
- text: phase.
- text: the larger of ends minus now and 0 hours when going, otherwise held.
- if going:
  - a button "Pause"; a tap sets held to ends minus now, then sets going to no.
- otherwise:
  - a button "Start"; a tap sets ends to now plus held, then sets going to yes.
- a button "Reset"; a tap sets going to no, then sets phase to Work, then sets round to 1, then sets held to 25 minutes.

request: classroom seating grid 5 rows by 6 columns where I tap a seat to put a student name in

program:
app "Seating" seat slate
table seat rw num 1..5, cl num 1..6, name text
state sr num = 1
state sc num = 1
state nm text
stat count(1..30, count(seat where rw = floor((it - 1) / 6) + 1 and cl = (it - 1) % 6 + 1) > 0), "seats filled"
grid 6 gap 1
  each 1..5 as rr
    each 1..6 as cc
      let cn = last(seat where rw = rr and cl = cc)
      box height 44 radius 8 tap set sr = rr then set sc = cc fill if(count(seat where rw = rr and cl = cc) > 0, accent, soft) stroke if(sr = rr and sc = cc, ink, edge)
        cn.name tiny align center
"Row" sr "seat" sc bold
field nm "Student name"
row gap 1
  button "Seat here" tap add seat rw = sr, cl = sc, name = nm then set nm = ""
  button "Clear seat" tap remove all seat where rw = sr and cl = sc
describe:
Seating, in the slate colours.
Keeps:
- seat: rw: number, 1 to 5; cl: number, 1 to 6; name: text. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Remembers while you use it: sr, starting at 1; sc, starting at 1; nm.
Shows:
- a big number: how many of the number from 1 to 30 have how many seat entries where rw is the result of the number minus 1 divided by 6 rounded down plus 1 and cl is the result of the number minus 1 leaves over when divided by 6 plus 1 is more than 0, labelled "seats filled".
- a grid of 6 columns:

    - for each number from 1 to 6:
      - a group; a tap sets sr to the number, then sets sc to the number:
        - text: the name of the cn.
- text: "Row", sr, "seat", sc.
- a box to fill in nm, labelled "Student name".

request: Tasbeeh counter. I pick the target: 33, 99 or 100, and it counts taps and tells me when I reach it. Also reset button.
program:
app "Tasbeeh" beads mint
table zikr
state n num = 0
state target num = 33
when n > 0 and n = target notify "Target reached"
row gap 1
  button "33" fill if(target = 33, accent, soft) tap set target = 33
  button "99" fill if(target = 99, accent, soft) tap set target = 99
  button "100" fill if(target = 100, accent, soft) tap set target = 100
draw width 240 tap set n = n + 1 then add zikr
  circle 44 stroke soft thick 8
  arc 44, 0, 360 * min(n, target) / target stroke if(n >= target, good, accent) thick 8
  label 50, 50, n big
if n >= target
  "Target of" target "reached" head color good
button "Reset" tap set n = 0
"Total count ever" count(zikr) faint
describe:
Tasbeeh, in the mint colours.
Keeps:
- zikr: just the time of each entry. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Remembers while you use it: n, starting at 0; target, starting at 33.
Shows:
- when n is more than 0 and n is target, it shows the notice "Target reached".
- a button "33"; a tap sets target to 33.
- a button "99"; a tap sets target to 99.
- a button "100"; a tap sets target to 100.
- a drawing made of circles, arcs, labels; a tap sets n to n plus 1, then adds a zikr.
- if n is at least target:
  - text: "Target of", target, "reached".
- a button "Reset"; a tap sets n to 0.
- text: "Total count ever", how many zikr entries.

Bill split, in the mint colours.
Works out:
- total is bill times the result of 1 plus the result of gst plus svc divided by 100.
Remembers while you use it: bill, starting at 0; gst, starting at 16; svc, starting at 10; people, starting at 4.
Shows:
- a box to fill in bill, labelled "Restaurant bill".
- a box to fill in gst, labelled "GST (percent)".
- a box to fill in svc, labelled "Service (percent)".
- a box to fill in people, labelled "People".
- a big number: total rounded, labelled "total with tax and service".
- a big number: total divided by people rounded, labelled "per person".
